brique._comment: Engine-native Reflexive family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: vocabulary.patch
objective.description: Patch the root vocabulary overlay, its LLM-readable text map, and projection.

#root.role: Run a root-only vocabulary patch, merge the overlay, regenerate the LLM-readable vocabulary map, update the projection, and expose patch statistics.

patch._comment: Required. Two accepted forms. Form 1 — hierarchical overlay: a nested JSON object deep-merged into vocabulary.json. Form 1 example: { "domain": { "status": ["active", "archived"] }, "media": { "format": ["mp3", "wav"] } }. Form 2 — value operations: { "add": [{ "path": string[] (key segment array), "value": any }], "remove": [{ "path": string[], "value": any }] }. Form 2 example: { "add": [{ "path": ["domain", "status"], "value": "review" }], "remove": [{ "path": ["domain", "status"], "value": "deprecated" }] }. Detection rule: if the patch object has an 'add' or 'remove' key whose value is an array, Form 2 is used; otherwise Form 1.

updated_nodes._comment: Number of vocabulary nodes touched in the projection during this patch.

updated_values._comment: Number of terminal values updated. Fixed to zero in v1 (value-specific accounting not tracked separately).

effects.projection_db: The root vocabulary projection may be updated.
effects.vocabulary_overlay: The root vocabulary JSON overlay file may be atomically rewritten.
effects.vocabulary_llm: The root LLM-readable vocabulary text file may be atomically regenerated from the JSON vocabulary tree.

transformation_contract.morphing: A root vocabulary patch becomes a new committed JSON overlay, regenerated LLM-readable vocabulary map, and projection state, with explicit patch statistics for the touched vocabulary nodes and values.
invariants: vocabulary.patch is root-only and rewrites the vocabulary overlay before updating the projection.
The JSON vocabulary file filters out string values containing spaces before it is written.
The LLM vocabulary file is derived from the JSON vocabulary tree and contains only the hierarchical category/path map, without values.
Patch application is a deterministic deep-merge where existing overlay values can override observed defaults.
Projection insertion is add-only in v1 and does not remove existing projected vocabulary nodes.
success: On success, vocabulary.patch returns updated_nodes, updated_values, and duration_ms.
Successful execution atomically writes vocabulary.json and vocabulary.llm.txt, then applies the patch to the vocabulary projection.
failure: The capacity is refused outside the root context.
The capacity fails when params.patch is missing, when the vocabulary JSON or LLM artifact cannot be written, or when the projection database cannot apply the add-only patch.
notes: updated_values is currently fixed to zero in v1 because value-specific accounting is not tracked separately.
This capability mutates derived vocabulary state, not source descriptors.
